response.original_title: Mo Dao Zu Shi (The Founder of Diabolism)
response.overview: As the grandmaster who founded the Demonic Sect, Wei Wuxian roamed the world in his wanton ways, hated by millions for the chaos he created. In the end, he was backstabbed by his dearest Shidi and killed by powerful clans. Thirteen years later, he is reincarnated into the body of a lunatic who was abandoned by his clan and is later taken away by his arch-nemesis-turned-soulmate, Lan Wangji. This marks the start of a thrilling yet hilarious journey of attacking monsters, solving mysteries, and raising children together.
response.tagline: To govern the spirit, one must master the path.
response.title: Mo Dao Zu Shi (The Founder of Diabolism)
